_comment: Hand edits for ranks 5001-10000 of the Japanese deck (tools/extend_deck_japanese.py). "_drop" removes a headword from the extension; "_keep" lets a headword past the proper-noun / name / fragment filters; any other key is a headword with {"gloss", "pos", "posName", "reading"} replacing the automatic values. Only the extension (ranks 5001+) is affected; the first 5,000 cards are never touched.

大福.gloss: daifuku (rice cake stuffed with sweet bean jam); great fortune; good luck

干支.gloss: sexagenary cycle; the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac

特撮.gloss: tokusatsu (live-action film or TV drama with special effects)

入所.gloss: admission (to a training institution, facility, etc.)

北陸.gloss: Hokuriku region (Niigata, Toyama, Ishikawa and Fukui)

本数.gloss: number of long thin objects (e.g. films, programs, games)

併設.gloss: joint establishment (esp. of schools of different levels)

件数.gloss: number of cases (e.g. accidents, crimes, meetings)

浴衣.gloss: yukata (light cotton summer kimono; also a bathrobe)

一筋.gloss: a strand (of hair, ray of light, etc.); earnest; single-minded

精霊.gloss: spirit; soul; ghost; spirit of the deceased

とことん.gloss: thoroughly; completely; to the very end
